ingredients.name: bell peppers, assorted colors, stemmed and seeded
unsalted butter, cut into small cubes

steps.instruction: Combine 1 cup of cream cheese and 2 strips of crisp, crumbled bacon.
Mix in 1/4 cup of unsalted butter, cut into small cubes.
Mix in salt, pepper and hot sauce to taste.
Put the mixture into a piping bag without a tip.
Pipe the mixture into 4 stemmed and seeded bell peppers.
Place the peppers on an ungreased half-sheet pan.
Bake for 35 minutes, until browned and bubbly on top.
